contexts.text: Under Deceit, see these references. SE 2855. SE 2856. SE 2876.
In that chamber... they consult how they may fraudulently deceive others.
Hunting = to deceive by persuasions, and by Knowledges which they pervert.
Still, they did not use these pretences in order to deceive by means of lies.
The deception of evils. Signified. Why evils deceive. Explained.
A Spirit acted in a more subtle manner than others... thus deceiving, which was natural to him...
Today he invents another wile, in order to deceive the innocent...
They seize truths and goods, but solely with the end of deceiving others.
Thus by deception they can bend the minds of others...
